text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*knock knock*)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, coming in~ It's about that new 
item—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, are you doing an experiment? What 
are you making today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, welcome, little witch. This time, 
it's an instant recovery potion for muscle 
soreness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Drinking this will instantly relieve 
muscle soreness. ...Well, the side effect 
is your hair turning rainbow-colored, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh, it turns into rainbow colors!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! It's like magic! Tachyon, you 
really do have the skills♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but since we're doing this, instead of 
just the color, how about we change a 
whole lot more?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like making your hair sparkle like stars, 
or making it smell sweet like candy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho... appealing to the senses of sight and 
smell, are you? Not bad. It will enhance 
relaxation and speed up physical recovery.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice, Sweep-kun. You 
always bring such vibrant flair to my 
ideas.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heheh, right?♪ You can thank me, you know!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, is it? Well then, let me brew some 
tea for you. It's what they call blooming 
tea—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...It'll be faster to just do it rather 
than explain. Let's brew it up real 
quick."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a flower is blooming inside the 
tea...!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The swaying petals are so gorgeous... I 
could stare at this forever...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like it. Still, you really do 
love flowers and all sorts of things, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because it's exciting, isn't it?♪ I love 
beautiful things, whether they're magical 
or not.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Perhaps I should try synthesizing a 
gemstone sometime. For instance, a 
magnetized one that relieves fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, jewels!? That's amazing! You've 
definitely gotta give them to me, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, volunteering to be my guinea 
pig? Heheh... In that case, you'll be 
accompanying me to the fullest.
